name: Global Circuit Innovations
old_description: “Global Circuit Innovations provided a form, fit and function solution to keep our Black Hawk helicopters flying.”
about:
Global Circuit Innovations, Inc. (GCI) is based in Colorado Springs, Colorado. The company specializes in electronic systems solutions for aerospace and defense platforms.

GCI develops electronic obsolescence solutions for legacy systems, drawing on decades of digital and analog circuitry experience. The company engineers circuit card assemblies for applications such as the DSM-157 test box used in Maverick missile testing, and provides environmental hardening for demanding conditions. Its hermetic product line delivers sealed electronic packages for high-reliability environments. Capabilities span electronic systems solutions, harsh-environment electronics, and research and development.

The company serves military aviation and missile programs. References include a form-fit-function replacement that kept Sikorsky Black Hawk helicopters operational, and obsolescence solutions for the U.S. Air Force F-16 fleet that are credited with saving tens of millions of dollars. Work also extends to Maverick missile test equipment.

GCI emphasizes cost-effective, proven obsolescence management and device-physics expertise for environmental hardening. The firm holds intellectual property and publishes technical papers supporting its approach to sustaining critical electronic systems.
